audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..6].side all read "Vex" while content win[0..6] all read "Zed", the packet levelChart is all Zed, and every phases[].why plus every whys[] describes Zed winning that stage. The page renders two different answers to who wins each level.
audit.why: Zed out-ranges nothing (Q 900 vs Mistral Bolt 1200) but wins on chip trades and the level 6 Death Mark threshold; the prose, the content layer and the packet all agree on Zed. Only the full-layer side column disagrees.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[].side set to Zed, matching win[N] which is already Zed (no win[N] edits proposed — they would be no-ops).

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text named the fear as "Gloom fear (passive)" and Vex's E as "Personal Space", and asserted her passive "rarely procs off you" because Zed uses shadow-swaps.
audit.why: Riot's kit: passive is Doom 'n Gloom (empowered next basic ability fears and interrupts dashes; nearby enemy dashes apply a mark that refunds the charge). W is Personal Space (475-range shield + nearby damage, 16/15/14/13/12). E is Looming Darkness (800 range, flat 12s slow/Gloom zone). Death Mark is explicitly a dash in Zed's own kit text, so it feeds her charge rather than dodging it.
audit.corrected: Spikes rebuilt on real names and cooldowns: Doom 'n Gloom charge state gates entry, Looming Darkness flat 12s is the trade window, Shadow Surge 140/120/100 is the pick timer.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated: Zed's R is a dash, so entering with Doom 'n Gloom lit gets him feared mid-commit, and his dash also refunds her charge cooldown. Text claimed the opposite.
audit.why: Zed R text: "Zed becomes untargetable and dashes to an enemy champion". Vex passive: fears and interrupts dashes; whenever a nearby enemy dashes she applies a mark that reduces the cooldown of her empowered state.
audit.corrected: Stated across cooldowns, dosFull, dontsFull, tradeBad, mid and spikes: enter only once the charge goes dark; Personal Space shields the Death Mark payoff tick.

audit.why: Real numbers exist in both kits.
audit.corrected: Looming Darkness flat 12s, Personal Space 16s rank 1, Living Shadow 20s rank 1.

Keep the CS lead, chip toward the 60% threshold, and do not facecheck her Looming Darkness zone for a cannon.

Trade in short bursts and leave on the returning shadow.
